01The field

Building blocks are largely met; self-replication is not

14done
0in progress
11open
14results landed

From building blocks to evolution. A separate track asks what happened on Earth (LUCA, timing, setting).

  1. L0
    Building blocks

    Made from a stated setting. Bennu's returned sample holds 33 amino acids, all five nucleobases and ribose.

    Largely met
  2. L1
    Activation and polymers

    Joined into chains under compatible conditions, without purifying between steps.

    Partly met
  3. L2
    Template copying

    A molecule copies function-length sequences. The 45-nucleotide QT45 ribozyme copied itself and its complement (Science 2026), at about 0.2% yield, under engineered conditions.

    Partly met
  4. L3
    Sustained self-replication

    Exponential growth from the setting's own feedstocks. Short RNAs, not yet a whole ribozyme, have been replicated exponentially from supplied triplets (2025).

    Not met
  5. L4
    Darwinian evolution

    Open-ended evolution in a compartment.

    Not met

  1. #25

    Dataset catalogue for origin-of-life research (Indus-style datasets/)tool18 Nov 2026

    92 datasets: 13 included, 67 fetch, 2 request, 10 reference-only (86 verified, 21 used). Gaps: no downloadable prebiotic reaction network, no step yields on crude inputs, no BIF/stromatolite or protocell data, Bennu/Ryugu samples on request only

    datasets/README.md

  2. #9

    Simulated-tree LUCA recoverynegative18 Nov 2026

    No gene-tree-free LUCA rule met the sealed mark (precision>=0.8 and recall>=0.5) in any of 10 loss/transfer cells, even with zero transfer; decisive R4 output = none. Strict rules keep precision but recall <=0.39; loose rules gain recall only as transfer drags precision under 0.8. Size estimate always overestimates (+28% at mu=2, tau/mu=0.1; +254% at tau/mu=3). Does not test Moody 2024 (ALE uses gene trees); means task #10 needs gene-tree reconciliation, not presence rules.

    experiments/luca_planted/RESULTS.md

  3. #6

    RAF null testnegative18 Nov 2026

    Reproduced Xavier et al. 2020 maxRAF exactly from their dataset S4 (1335 reactions excl. 22 Pooling rows), but it is not larger than its nulls: degree-preserving rewiring gives 3394-3583 (real far below, p_lower=0.001) and degree-matched random food gives 705-1403 (real inside, p_upper=0.064). Pre-registered verdict: within null; uniform random food (0-34) is an invalid null per #8.

    experiments/raf_null/RESULTS.md

  4. #7

    Assembly index vs a size-only nullmixed18 Nov 2026

    Mass-matched Rhea vs GDB (889 pairs): MA adds dAUC 0.061 [0.037,0.089] over MW+HA and beats LZ by 0.054 [0.020,0.085], but biotic MA is lower at matched HA (-0.52 [-0.60,-0.44]); signal tracks ring-rich GDB scaffolds. Marshall mixtures: peaks vs m/z dAUC 0.115 [-0.19,0.42], underpowered. Hazen minerals all below organic MA-HA trend. Refit planted check passed 100% (run after primary ran, before read); OOF planted check failed. M6 red-team #22 added.

    experiments/assembly_null/RESULTS.md

  5. #8

    Planted autocatalytic core recoverymixed18 Nov 2026

    maxRAF code exact (400/400 vs brute force) and contains every planted core (180/180, k=20-1000), but size-vs-null detection is weak: degree-preserving rewiring (N1) has FPR 1/20 and 0/20 and flags k=1000 cores 20/20 and 12/20, k=100 only 2/20 and 0/20. Uniform random food (N3) is invalid (FPR 18/20, 20/20); degree-matched food (N3m) never flags anything and sits low 14-18/20 with nothing planted.

    experiments/raf/RESULTS.md

  6. #18

    Net replication per cycle from Attwater 2025negative18 Nov 2026

    experiments/pathway_map/RESULTS.md

  10. #2

    QT45 numbers from the paper and depositnegative18 Nov 2026

    On published QT45 numbers (0.24%/0.17% full-length yield per 72 d; t1/2 117 d) a strand population shrinks: lambda=0.43 per (+)->(-)->(+) cycle, break-even needs ~53% yield per 72 d (262x more), and lambda<1 for any half-life under ~68 y. The second-hand '0.02%' is the per-ribozyme yield (0.024%); per template it is 0.24%.

    experiments/qt45_numbers/RESULTS.md

Note: its 10^5 yield gain came from selective TMP enrichment downstream, which the rule scores as a yield, not a process; no change needed.

    experiments/research_sweep/RESULTS.md

(1) datasets/catalog.csv listing EVERY open or requestable dataset relevant to this project, not only ones we use, with columns: id, title, kind, tier (included / fetch / request / reference-only), origin URL or DOI, terms/licence, size, n subjects or records, what ground truth or labels it has, which of our tasks it serves, used_by_us, notes. Inputs: experiments/assembly_null/out/molecules.csv + ma_cache.jsonl. Report whether the positive survives and in which direction.

  • #24Red-team the Xavier 2020 'within null' result (#6)Open

    Treat the negative like a positive and try to break it before it is shown as a finding. Check: (1) the reproduction of 1,335 vs our 1,357 reactions, and which food set and catalysis annotations were used; (2) whether degree-preserving rewiring keeps chemistry valid (mass balance, cofactor roles), or inflates maxRAF with impossible reactions; (3) whether the degree-matched food null is fair to the original claim, which was about the food set they chose; (4) whether the verdict changes under a chemistry-respecting null (e.g. swap only within reaction classes, or EC-level shuffles); (5) what Xavier et al. actually claimed (read the paper's own wording; do not strawman). Output experiments/raf_null/REDTEAM.md with survives / weakened / overturned and the reason. No new compute beyond 30 min; use board/run.sh.

    Needs task #6 first.
